summary: A 1935 L-4 cab on the summit of Hawley Mountain in Boise County; a forest road reaches it, and a climbing guide calls it no longer in use.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a concrete base (8 or 10 feet; sources differ)

visit.trail_note: Forest road FS-374 runs north from Harris Creek Summit about 10.4 miles to the lookout; high clearance is needed in a couple of spots, per a climbing guide.

events.note: L-4 cab on a concrete base; described as the only structure ever built on the summit
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description: wooden building about 14 feet square on a concrete base
Two-story lookout house with an R4-80 cab and concrete-walled lower level, per Forest Lookouts; not reconciled with the 1935 cab
A youth who broke into a lookout atop Hawley Mountain was caught; the Boise National Forest began fitting lookouts with break-in recorders
Registered September 28, 2020, nominated by Brad Eells

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 7,300 ft and firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 7301 ft; these are the same figure to within a foot.

notes_for_editor: Conflicts not resolved: base height 8 ft (register, Idaho Fire Lookouts) vs 10 ft (firelookout.com); design R1/L-4 (register) vs L-4 (others); the 1963 two-story house with an R4-80 cab (Forest Lookouts only) is not reconciled with the 1935 L-4. The 1959 survey wording on Forest Lookouts (14 ft square, wooden, concrete base) fits either account. Current status is thin: Idaho Fire Lookouts says 'Drive-Up Emergency Status' with no date shown; the Idaho Climbing Guide says 'no longer in use' with no date shown. Whether the cab is open to visitors is not stated anywhere read. A web search snippet mentioned an onX listing saying the lookout is no longer manned and an Idaho Statesman item on the road loop; neither was read, so neither is cited. The record's height_m of 3.0 is near a 10-foot base but the register and Idaho Fire Lookouts say 8 feet; not changed. Recommend a Boise National Forest check on current status, road access and the 1963 house before publishing.
